zoe: Quick sync  platform wants a machine-readable v2 for routing/quota rejects so Console can show a direct recovery flow. Sketch below; SDK owners, any hard blockers?
kartik: Paste the shape please. console needs a stable code field to switch UX.
zoe: Example when header X-RW-RouteErrors: v2 sent -> 409 + JSON: {"code":"ROUTE_POLICY_EXCEEDED","policy":"quota.bulk-embeddings","allowed":0,"requested":1,"hint":"upgrade-plan","meta":{"org":"org-11"}}. SDKs should expose RoutePolicyError with these props.
abril: TS SDK: fine to add subclass. We'll add constructor flag routeErrorsV2: 'auto'|'on'|'off' and env var RW_ROUTE_ERRORS_V2. Effort ~0.5d + tests & docs. Keep 409 (no remap).
kartik: Py SDK: same. Ensure `except RedwoodAPIError` still catches it. Add fallback for legacy 400 parsing. Also docs note: do not auto-retry on these errors.
zoe: Rollout plan: server feature-flag; header opt-in for canary (5%). SDKs ship opt-in. Console flips header for beta orgs. Collect telemetry event routing.policy_reject with sampled tenant. No Retry-After header.
abril: I'll open a PR, tag sdk:route-errors-v2 and release patch opt-in-only.
deploy-bot: deploy: feature/route-errors-v2 -> canary started (5%). build ci-9322.
zoe: Thanks  post PR links and any integration failures here.
